@graph.name: Miami-Dade Hospitals
@graph.description: A point feature class of the hospital facilities within Miami-Dade County.

additionalProperty.name: process_step
additionalProperty.value:
#########
  # GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
  # and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
  ####
  
  #########
  # Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
  ####
  
  # create directory structure and move into it
  mkdir -p /data/mdc_hospitals/download -p /data/mdc_hospitals/etl
  chmod -R 777 /data/mdc_hospitals
  cd /data/mdc_hospitals
  
  # set update flag based on last update and update frequency
  do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1
  
  # download if update flag is set:
  if do_update == 1 then
  wget --retry-connrefused --waitretry=1 --read-timeout=20 --timeout=15 -t 10 -O download/mdc_hospitals.json 'https://services.arcgis.com/8Pc9XBTAsYuxx9Ny/arcgis/rest/services/Hospital_gdb/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=json' 2>&1
  
  # load into postGIS with:
  ogr2ogr -lco GEOMETRY_NAME=geom -f PostgreSQL PG:"<postgres connection>" download/mdc_hospitals.json -nlt point -nln mdc_hospitals
  echo success: mdc_hospitals.json loaded with ogr2ogr
  
  
  #########
  # Step 2 - SQL script (pseudo code):
  ####
  
  # remove duplicate points and make geometries valid:
  UPDATE mdc_hospitals
    SET geom=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(geom));
  
  # add local geometry column and reproject existing geometries into local EPSG:
  ALTER TABLE mdc_hospitals DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS geom_local CASCADE;
  SELECT AddGeometryColumn (
    'mdc_hospitals',
    'geom_local', 2236, 'point', 2
  );
  UPDATE mdc_hospitals
    SET geom_local=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(ST_Transform(geom,2236)));
  CREATE INDEX mdc_hospitals_geom_local_idx
    ON mdc_hospitals
    USING GIST (geom_local);
  NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
  # Move into corrrect directory and create derivative directory in data package on osgeo
  cd /data/mdc_hospitals/
  mkdir -p derived
  
  # Move into correct directory
  cd /data/mdc_hospitals/
  
  # Create pg_dump of table SQL in derivate directory on postgis.
  pg_dump <postgres opts> -h gaia-db -t mdc_hospitals > derived/mdc_hospitals.sql
  
  # Create downloadable tarfile of SQL in derivative directory on postgis
  rm -f derived/mdc_hospitals.sql.tar.gz
  tar -czf derived/mdc_hospitals.sql.tar.gz meta_dcat_mdc_hospitals.json -C derived mdc_hospitals.sql
